title: James Lounger #23 Persistence Layer to Braun Memory Storage Bridge Audit

gate.question: Does Lounger #23 expose a dynamic persistent James-session source that bridges into Braun's memory/storage layer, rather than merely static terminal notes?
gate.monitor_result: The Dad monitor/status/stress surface is backed by static NOTE assets and the Dad pod script contains no dynamic memory read or persistence operation.
gate.backend_result: Visiontron architecture explicitly routes occupant input through lounger hardware to an external processing center; Vault 112 uses the Think Machine 3600r as that computer control/processing system.
gate.open_boundary: No reviewed shipped asset directly binds James's session state in the Think Machine 3600r to a named memory-store object, mem-chip carrier, snapshot handle, archive record or export reference.

records.role: static resident-status text for James-specific monitor
static resident-stress text for James-specific monitor

records.finding: No dynamic memory read, persistence, archive, copy, write or export operation is exposed.

lounger23_monitor_audit.interpretation: Post-exit visibility of Dad monitor data can be explained by persistent static assets; it is not sufficient evidence that James autobiographical memory remains live behind the monitor.

findings: A Visiontron/Tranquility lounger contains hardware that processes the occupant's input into the simulation.
The actual simulation runs through a processing center connected to the lounger.
Vault 112's processing/computer-control system is the Think Machine 3600r.
Vault 112 is highly automated and requires only one administrator, Stanislaus Braun.
visiontron_backend_architecture.significance: James's active neural/simulation session necessarily traverses a centralized backend distinct from the Lounger #23 terminal NOTE surface.

evidence: Remote pod access is allowed to User S. Braun with privileges.
Neural inputs were updated to override memory access for individual users.
Braun can alter subject state and specifically transformed James into Doc.
Braun can reset/restart resident simulation state while safety protocols remain active.

facts: Pinkerton stole from Braun a physical mem chip already containing an unknown person's memories.
Pinkerton later imported those memories into A3-21.
Therefore a Vault112/Braun-domain process had represented memory state on a removable carrier at least once.
not_proven: that every lounger has a dedicated removable mem chip
that James's Lounger #23 automatically writes to one
that the Think Machine stores James in an addressable persistent snapshot
that the carrier is rewritable on demand

save_james_effect.improvement: The persistence search is moved away from the static Lounger #23 monitor and into the actual Visiontron -> Think Machine 3600r processing path through which James's neural session must pass.

ru: Lounger #23 остаётся James-specific endpoint, но его видимые status/stress данные являются статическими NOTE assets и не доказывают живой memory backup.
Настоящий путь James-session проходит через Visiontron в внешний processing center; в Vault 112 эту роль выполняет Think Machine 3600r.
Braun имеет привилегированный remote pod и per-user memory control, поэтому следующий storage bridge следует искать в Think Machine/Braun backend, а не в Dad-monitor UI.
Заполненный mem chip, украденный Pinkerton у Braun, доказывает существование класса memory-state-to-removable-carrier, но не связывает этот carrier конкретно с James.
SAVE JAMES усиливается до central-backend-bound conditional reconstruction, но persisted James memory state пока не установлен.

next_gate.name: THINK_MACHINE_3600R_JAMES_SESSION_STATE_AND_MEMORY_CARRIER_ASSOCIATION_AUDIT
targets: Search shipped and cut assets for Think Machine 3600r references associated with Vault112 session state, resident memory, neural input, archive, restoration or persistence.
Search Visiontron/lounger scripts for linked refs, parent refs, activation targets or hidden containers connecting individual pods to backend state objects.
Search Braun/Betty dialogue INFO result scripts and MQ04 stage scripts for operations that select or restore a specific resident through backend identifiers.
Search for any Vault112 resident-memory table, array, alias, token or carrier association outside terminal NOTE records.
If James-specific backend state is found and survives or can be exported after MQ04 exit, promote SAVE JAMES to PERSISTED_JAMES_MEMORY_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION.
